Try Shrunked Image Resizer (https://github.com/memeller/shrunked).

- In the right column, click the 'Latest' button

- scroll down and click right-click 'shrunked_image_resizer-5.10.3.xpi' > click 'Save link as' and save it somewhere

- open TB menu > Add-ons and Themes

- click the gear to the right > Install Add-on From File

- navigate to where you saved the .xpi file > double-click it

Thanks, but I think I didn't make myself clear. I'm not looking to change the original size of images — I just want them to display properly, like Foxmail does with width="90%" and height="auto" so they fit the text area without being cropped. Does Thunderbird have anything like that?

If I understand correctly, Faellesnet provides you internet access, but does not offer email service. Three popular free email providers are gmail.com, outlook.com, and gmx.com. All three work well with Thunderbird and all three offer IMAP or POP. For each, I encourage becoming familiar with the online features before setting up with thunderbird because there may be some features that are not accessible to thunderbird.
